sections: Report 1 — Roblox Engine Physics: Documentation of the "What", Silence on the "How"
1.1 Three layers of evidence separate contract from algorithm
1.2 The assembly is the rigid body; inertia can only be read, not written
1.3 A full-coordinate PGS solver, known only through semi-official sources
1.4 240 Hz step, adaptive islands and an engine declared non-deterministic
1.5 Exact contact only for balls, blocks, wedges and corner wedges; friction by weighted average
1.6 Idealized constraints: no compliance, no breakage and no reaction readout
1.7 Movers, impulses and direct writes: only forces and impulses are physical loads
1.8 Sleep and spatial queries have their own thresholds
1.9 Five facts dominate the design space, and the platform's recent direction attacks three of them
1.10 Consolidated catalog: every official technology, with status on 2026-10-24 and Creator Hub link
Report 2 — Units and Physical Consistency: A Coherent System with Another Planet's Gravity
2.1 Three primary units and an engine that declares itself neutral

2.6 Unit gaps that directly affect design

Report 3 — Vehicle Dynamics: Fidelity Must Follow the Phenomenon, Not the Count of Degrees of Freedom
3.0 Signs first: ISO 8855 and SAE J670 differ by a 180° rotation about x
3.1 Longitudinal dynamics: Newton, transferred load and the mass factor that holds only without slip
3.2 Lateral dynamics: the understeer gradient governs the steady state, but not the transient
3.3 Vertical dynamics: linear to first order, dominated by nonlinearities in discrete events
3.4 The model hierarchy: each level captures one more phenomenon
3.5 The phenomena that require nonlinearity are precisely those that define "realism"
3.6 The causal chain of directional behavior and the criterion for simplification
3.7 Worked examples: under 196.2 studs/s², roll sits at 69% of the gravitational limit (expanded edition)

Report 4 — Tires and Contact: The Most "Scientific" Model Is Not the Most Useful Without Data

4.6 Contact representations: from the single ray to the envelope
4.7 Double application: the native solver does not know that the script has already computed the tire
4.8 Project Chrono: the interface is transferable; the infrastructure is not
4.10 Worked examples: the combined MF and the complete TMeasy, and the lateral μ that falls to 0.39 under 5.6 nominal loads (expanded edition)
Report 5 — Suspension and Steering: Visually Similar Geometry Does Not Reproduce True Kinematics

5.7 Representations in Roblox: constraints, raycast, multibody and hybrids
5.8 Steering in Roblox: native servo, no readable aligning torque
Report 6 — Powertrain, Brakes and Aerodynamics: Torque Is the Cause, Wheel Speed Is the Consequence
6.1 Combustion engine: power, inertia and drag torque

6.4 Gearbox and final drive: losses in the direction of power flow

6.6 Differentials: the open one splits torque, the limited-slip one splits by the bias ratio
6.7 Electric motors and regeneration: constant torque, then constant power
6.8 Physical torque versus prescribed wheel speed, and what Roblox hinge motors really are
6.9 Brakes and driver aids: the physics is pressure → torque → slip; ABS, EBD and ESC are algorithms

6.11 Fluid forces in Roblox: a beta aerodynamic model with no published equations
